scope: related-domain transfer pilot; not independent workload-family confirmation

primary.endpoint: best verified feasible whole-program speedup by budget; cycle-reduction regret to complete measured pool

measurement_plan: Run one prospective live agent episode first, allowing only one-at-a-time host measurement feedback and at most three paid attempts. Only after the episode closes, serially measure all remaining pool members (one attempt each) to establish the complete reference pool. Then run the prespecified non-agent policy replay from hidden per-policy callbacks at budgets one, two and three. The physical dataset collection costs up to twelve candidate evaluations; replay trajectories do not erase that cost.

model_protocol.existing_pairwise_ranker: XGBRanker rank:pairwise, 80 trees, depth 2, learning rate .05, fixed seed; no target labels
model_protocol.existing_factorized_model: existing feasibility/analytic-benefit XGBoost recipe, seeds 0-4, fixed current settings
model_protocol.active_learning: existing hybrid Gaussian-process acquisition and paid-update implementation; no retuning

agent_protocol.scope: one prospective live current-Codex chat-relay episode with host-measured target observations
agent_protocol.model_label: current Codex chat model; exact deployment ID unavailable
agent_protocol.structured_action: one strict JSON object per response through the local bridge; no Responses API call is claimed
agent_protocol.model_bundle: seed-0 XGBRanker objective=rank:pairwise trained on historical measured whole-program speedup orderings, plus a 20-member XGBClassifier hardware-feasibility ensemble multiplied by public analytic cycle savings; target workload/families excluded

ml_training.labels: historical whole-program measured speedup; measured area/timing feasibility

agent_protocol.llm_training: No LLM fine-tuning. Prompt-based current Codex model receives structured state, predictions and bounded retrieved historical examples through a tool loop.

memory.store: local TF-IDF / truncated-SVD historical memory; one measured record per chunk
memory.retrieval: lexical plus latent-semantic cosine with reciprocal-rank fusion
memory.knowledge_graph: available in the memory subsystem and logged in provenance; not queried in hybrid mode
memory.target_outcomes: never indexed or retrieved; only the agent's own paid observations are returned in the active request

agent_protocol.human_in_loop: A human relay supplies the current chat model's JSON action to the bridge. The host validates action schema, identity and budget before dispatch; no claim is made that a separate reviewer approves each measurement.
agent_protocol.stop_rule: Host finalizes the best paid verified feasible improvement, otherwise the baseline.
observability: retrieved record IDs and source hashes
verified SQLite projection of decisions, model calls, retrievals, contexts and tools
